profile.course_name: Damai Indah Golf BSD (via DMIG associate); Karawang Bukit Golf (PT Karawang Bukit Golf, direct subsidiary); residential "Rancamaya Golf" expansion (FY2024)
profile.ownership_summary: Property/township conglomerate; holds equity interests in DMIG (golf operator); direct ownership of PT Bintaro Serpong Damai (1.07%, 1993, toll road) and many subsidiaries
profile.region_city: BSD City (Tangerang); Karawang (Karawang Bukit Golf, Tol Jakarta-Cikampek KM47, Telukjambe Timur); Rancamaya residential (Bogor)
profile.area_ha: N/A -- Not Disclosed in AR (BSD City total >6000 ha; golf is small fraction)
profile.holes: N/A in AR (DMIG provides 36-hole; Karawang Bukit Golf hole count not disclosed)
profile.architect_designer: N/A -- Not Disclosed in AR (DMIG PIK course = Robert Trent Jones Jr.)
profile.member_categories: N/A in BSDE AR; refer to DMIG AR for golf membership terms
profile.facilities: Multiple Club Houses (The Avani, The Icon, Vanya Park) + Sports Clubs (Banjar Wijaya, Grand Wisata, Kota Wisata) + Eldorado Waterpark Legenda Wisata + BSD Modern Market + offices + residences
profile.revenue_segments_disclosed: Property development + recurring rental (golf is non-material at consolidated level)
profile.source_pages: BSDE/FY2023 p.101; BSDE/FY2024 p.51; BSDE/FY2022 p.73
